key_idea: Simulate FCFS scheduling with a min-heap of core free times, collect all completion times, sort them and take the largest gap (including the gap from time 0 to the first completion).
sketch: Each job starts at 0 if a core is free, otherwise at the smallest finishing time popped from the heap; push start+d. Sort the n completion times and take the max difference of consecutive ones, starting from 0. O(n log n). Pitfalls: k > n, equal completion times (gap 0), and counting the initial wait from time 0.
